verdict.rationale: Signifyd documents a REST API that can retrieve the latest fraud decision for a single order and webhooks for decision events. Nothing in the evidence shows a review-queue endpoint for pulling flagged cases with their context, or any agent-facing capability to summarize evidence and recommend a decision for human confirmation. These are developer building blocks at most, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can work the review queue — pull flagged cases with their context, summarize the evidence, and recommend a decision for a human to confirm
